items.title: October 10 review items
items.box:
October 10 review items.

WHAT: act on the master review of 2026-10-10 (design/reviews/claude-clowd/2026-10-10-master-review.md, read-only review of master at e8f8ffd7, Sep 18 to Oct 10). Andy, 2026-10-12: "yes open that goal as "October 10 review items"".
Of about forty findings, 2 are fixed (net.fetch buffering, the Stop flag) and 4 partly; the rest stand. Each item holds its findings and today's evidence.

TOPICS: seats; the goal Done gates; deskVerify (its tab, its suites); desk checks; git helpers; deskUnsloth robustness; shell trust in streamed objects; the net.fetch gate; the face; hygiene.

OUTSIDE THE REPO, his: rotate the sk-unsloth key committed in a2786053 (the file is untracked since 30218a86, the key is still in history).

items.title: Seats kept on first connect, given up when evicted
items.box:
Seats kept on first connect, given up when evicted.

FOUND (Checked against the tree at f0d03916 (2026-10-12); paths under spirit/run/ unless noted.)
- HIGH: the first stream to a new relay erases the seat the claim just wrote. js/hub.js:1160 seats; js/answerRelay.js:201 calls relayKeys.accept on a "new" verdict; js/relayKeys.js:196-202 rewrites the whole row. Every new node reads "You (unknown)". test/presenceProof.js:70 never checks the label.
- HIGH: a seat is never given up. relayKeys.unseat (js/relayKeys.js:159) has no caller; any pin counts as a seat (:138-146); ownerBadge.js:408 claimed = owned || hasSeat; natterDetails.js:580 hides the claim form.
- An owner CAN evict: Contacts details > Forget twice (shell/contactsDetails/contactsDetails.js:363-388) sends removePeer to each relay (relay.js:3403-3406 then forgetPeer :2258). The evicted node is never told, keeps its seat, and can never re-claim.
- MEDIUM: a re-claim answered 409 for the node's own key records no seat (hub.js:1135-1143); "a boot can still backfill" (:1161) is false.
- MEDIUM: the seat label is frozen at claim time (ownerBadge.js:426,431); a rename from Info (info.js:285) never re-seats; natter.js:811-815 says otherwise.
- LOW: natterDetails.js:433 reads c.peers, :1048 reads roll.roster; the probe sets neither. Andy's reading: rules for seats, but no code for the owner to evict members.

items.title: Goal Done gates: reds, stop, reopen, restart
items.box:
Goal Done gates: reds, stop, reopen, restart.

FOUND (Checked against the tree at f0d03916 (2026-10-12); paths under spirit/run/ unless noted.)
- goalRun (process/js/deskVerify/deskVerify.js:612-614) calls verify.pass on the goal whatever runList returns: reds, a Stop by hand or a missing file all still bring Done. fullRun no longer passes (4be68252).
- A reopened goal keeps checked and emptied (process/js/desk/desk.js:785 clears done, closed, alone and claims only; :594, :625, :815), so Done returns without a new run.
- A deskVerify restart during a goal run blocks the goal's Done for good: the first walk is history (deskVerify.js:502), goalsRun is in memory (:454, :515), goal.emptied is written once, and verify.again refuses a goal.
- Missed by the review: full.run sends id '' when no goal row is current (shell/desk/desk.js:1342), and its report line then fails in silence.

items.title: deskVerify: the Verifier tab vanishes when work is queued
items.box:
deskVerify: the Verifier tab vanishes when work is queued.

FOUND (Checked against the tree at f0d03916 (2026-10-12); paths under spirit/run/ unless noted.)
- The now verb declares queued: [''] but returns objects (process/js/deskVerify/deskVerify.js:754-756); appServer refuses the reply as handler-failed (js/appServer.js:196); the page then sets deskVerifier = null (shell/desk/desk.js:1014), and queued.map(deskEsc) (:1091) would draw [object Object].

items.title: deskVerify: kill a suite's servers; normalise listed paths
items.box:
deskVerify: kill a suite's servers; normalise listed paths.

FOUND (Checked against the tree at f0d03916 (2026-10-12); paths under spirit/run/ unless noted.)
- Stop and the time limit kill the suite process only (process/js/deskVerify/deskVerify.js:177 spawns without detached; :187, :231 kid.kill()), so its servers live on and the next suite collides on lab ports. runAll spawns detached and kills the group.
- Listed file paths are not normalised: spirit/test/../../x.js passes the regex (deskVerify.js:306, :602; process/js/desk/desk.js:2169 accepts any non-empty string).
- A plain item's verify.reject is always refused by the desk (desk.js:2087 needs code), so only the chat line records a red.

items.title: Desk checks: numbers never repeat; box blur on its own item
items.box:
Desk checks: numbers never repeat; box blur on its own item.

FOUND (Checked against the tree at f0d03916 (2026-10-12); paths under spirit/run/ unless noted.)
- Check numbers are count + 1 (process/js/desk/desk.js:525), item.files.add deletes and renumbers G checks (:698-702), check.set takes the first match (:533): numbers repeat and a grant can land on the wrong check.
- The item dialog's box blur uses the live ddId (shell/deskDetails/deskDetails.js:473, :480); open() changes it without resetting ddBoxFocused (:610), so a take or write can land on the newly opened item.

items.title: Git helpers: deskClient pull, publishData, pushOrigin
items.box:
Git helpers: deskClient pull, publishData, pushOrigin.

FOUND (Checked against the tree at f0d03916 (2026-10-12); paths under spirit/run/ unless noted.)
- deskClient runs a synchronous git pull --rebase with a 60 s timeout inside next (process/js/deskClient/deskClient.js:236, :242, :273), past the node's 12 s door; rebase --abort (:244) can abort the agent's own rebase.
- publishData adds its file then runs a plain git commit (process/js/deskClient/publishData.js:181-182), so other staged work goes out as "publish:".
- pushOrigin ignores git stash pop's status and pops the top stash, not its own (process/js/pushOrigin/pushOrigin.js:54); on a detached HEAD it pushes HEAD:HEAD (:32-33, :67); its header says no retries, MAX_PUSH_TRIES = 3 (:41).
- LOW: goalShare's "same" short-cut never fires because desk.js:1364 writes writtenAt (384 currentGoal.json commits since 2026-09-12); commitCheck matches pending commits by subject only (process/js/desk/commitCheck.js:240, :291).

items.title: deskUnsloth: timeouts, tool results in the room, working reset
items.box:
deskUnsloth: timeouts, tool results in the room, working reset.

FOUND (Checked against the tree at f0d03916 (2026-10-12); paths under spirit/run/ unless noted.)
- The chat-completion call has no timeout (process/js/deskUnsloth/deskUnsloth.js:399), and working is reset only on success (:1048): a hung or failed answer leaves Levant silent until restart.
- Two of three model-refresh calls have no timeout (deskUnsloth.js:525: cached-gguf and inference/status).
- Tool results are cut each to a quarter of the room but never counted against the prompt room over up to three rounds (deskUnsloth.js:418, :295; tools.js:153).
- The Remote: a load refusal published before the answer leaves the hourglass stuck (shell/deskUnslothRemote/deskUnslothRemote.js:499, :460); a target switch keeps the old transcript and busy flags (:715-726); a published state re-enables the switch mid-flip (:458).
- LOW: lastChat is one global (deskUnsloth.js:617, :958); model.load with no id writes "undefined" (:1175); ANSWER_TOKENS falls to 0 (:112); tools declare required: [] (tools.js:116); describeAll reruns every ask (:360); an error field in a fetched JSON reads "the node refused" (tools.js:146-147).

items.title: Shell: published objects only from the node's own puppets
items.box:
Shell: published objects only from the node's own puppets.

FOUND (Checked against the tree at f0d03916 (2026-10-12); paths under spirit/run/ unless noted.)
- js/client/shell.js:1983-1994 and :2208 deliver a streamed object from any fromKey. These ignore the sender: shell/chatter/chatter.js:347, shell/desk/desk.js:441 and :1131, shell/deskDetails/deskDetails.js:374, shell/ruleDetails/ruleDetails.js:213. Any contact can push objects into the master's apps (a change:1e12 freezes the desk view; a fake chat line can name another peer). Only deskUnslothRemote checks the sender (:448).

items.title: net.fetch gate: refuse loopback, private, link-local
items.box:
net.fetch gate: refuse loopback, private, link-local.

FOUND (Checked against the tree at f0d03916 (2026-10-12); paths under spirit/run/ unless noted.)
- Levant no longer has net.fetch (process/js/deskUnsloth/deskUnsloth.js:307, removed in b355e36d). But the gate is unchanged: js/proxyList.js:227-244 refuses only closed entries, so 127.0.0.1, private ranges and 169.254.169.254 pass for any caller of the node's door (js/server.js:1774, gate at :668-669). A request the node makes to itself passes the door checks.
- Buffering is fixed: js/server.js:690-698 pipes the reply (bb8aeb85).

items.title: Face: no identity.json in appFaceApp; FACE.md; appApi.js
items.box:

- bash/FACE.md:79 (repo root) still places face-domain.json in app/appFaceApp/, but the code reads its --state folder (appFaceApp.js:88); no process-grant step; puppetPost still named at bash/FACE.md:9,23, bash/face-tls:3,35, bash/face-install:44, bash/systemd/spirit-face.service:14.
- spirit/test/appApi.js:108 still calls client.startAll(), removed in 013dc827.
- LOW: spiritErrors (js/spiritErrors.js:91, :95), appFaceAppServer.js:42's sentence, appFaceApp.js:143 without an error field, faceRoute.js helpers used only by a test, jobs.js:266/:328 options.module, spirit/test/puppetsPending.js:195,202 crediting the deleted puppetOwner.js.

items.title: Hygiene: temp_loop, localEar leftovers, dead code, stale notes
items.box:
Hygiene: temp_loop, localEar leftovers, dead code, stale notes.

FOUND (Checked against the tree at f0d03916 (2026-10-12); paths under spirit/run/ unless noted.)
- At the repo root, tracked: temp_loop.js, temp_loop2.js to temp_loop6.js, temp_loop_clean.js, temp-desk-reply.js (UTF-16). Andy: "The temp_loop/.js scratch file gotta go."
- localEar leftovers: process/js/desk/reply.js (UTF-16, throws on load), localEar.json pointing at a deleted localEar.js, create-localEar.js.
- process/js/deskUnsloth/configuration.json is still tracked although .gitignore:92 lists it; it holds no secret.
- process/js/fileServer/fileServer.js:107-110: Buffer.alloc(length) with no cap (CHUNK = 6000 at :138).
- Dead code: relay.who (relay.js:896), hub.handleMatches (:573), hub.handleWho and withRelay (:1560, :1009), relayKeys.unseat (if 19.1 does not give it a caller); the deskVerify verbs only tests call (loop.once, suites, goal.check, claim.check, chore.once, idle, mode, records.search).
- Stale words: whoBook / who.json in DICTIONARY.md, AGENT.md, CLAUDE.md, CLINE.md, relay.js:1765, .gitignore:128, UI_DESIGN_STYLE.md, labMaster/BONES.md, test/peerPostWiring.js; comments leaning on the deleted /api/relay/who route (natterDetails.js:460, hub.js:2077, relay.js:2365, 3097, 3492, 4254, 1062, js/relayStatus.js:15, server.js:2063); others describing removed behaviour.
- Repo notes: .gitignore:218-220 pasted console.log lines; .claude/settings.json:4 a one-machine path; CLINE.md a byte copy of CLAUDE.md; notASuite.js lists the deleted appServerWorlds.js and labMaster.js in a subfolder, and its own header makes runAll take it for a suite; rollNarrow.js guards only partly (:64, :77, :144, :152).
